name: contextprint
description: Audits a repository against the contextprint approach (numbered requirements, minimal-hybrid specs, DSL contracts, acceptance tests, AGENTS.md router, CI enforcement), scaffolds missing artifacts as templates, and a writer agent drafts the missing documents from real sources.
suggestedPrompts: Audit this repo for context-layer readiness and list the missing artifacts
Scaffold templates for the missing context-layer artifacts (dry run first)
Use the contextprint-writer agent to write the missing documents from the audit report
